title: SDLC Phase Gate Rules
description: Canonical phase exit gate criteria for the Evolith 5-phase SDLC. Each gate requires objective evidence; manual confidence cannot override a failed gate.

gates.name: Business Sign-Off
gates.description: Scope frozen; funding authorized; architectural constraints aligned.

mandatoryEvidence.validation: PRD status = Approved AND approvalEvidence present AND date filled
Initiative registered with customer pain points and expected value
Financial viability documented with KPIs
T-Shirt sizing completed with team composition
MoSCoW analysis completed for Phase 0 with at least one MUST item and valid priority distribution

gates.name: Design Baseline Approved
gates.description: Architecture decisions are documented; bounded contexts defined; functional stories written.

mandatoryEvidence.validation: All architecture decisions have corresponding ADR. No undocumented decisions.
All Functional Stories in Ready state with BDD acceptance criteria
Product architecture diagrams traceable to Evolith Reference Blueprint
Passed — no over-engineering detected
All contexts identified with ownership and persistence strategy

blockingCriteria.action: BLOCK — require ADR before design baseline

gates.name: Successful Build
gates.description: All code merged to main; CI passes; quality gates green; definition of done satisfied.

mandatoryEvidence.validation: All technical stories Done; traceable to Functional Stories
CI run green on main branch. No failing tests, no lint errors, no security scan failures
All DoD items checked per Technical Story
Updated ADRs, inline documentation, README changes included in merge
Business logic coverage >= 80% per Quality Thresholds rules

blockingCriteria.action: BLOCK merge — fix CI before merge
BLOCK merge — add tests or request waiver
BLOCK merge — remediate CVEs or request security waiver

gates.waiverAuthority: Architecture Board (with exception for CVEs requires Executive Risk Acceptance)

gates.name: RC Stamped
gates.description: All quality thresholds verified; security scans clean; UAT passed; release candidate formally approved.

mandatoryEvidence.validation: All quality gates green or explicitly waived. RC stamped by QA Lead and Tech Lead.
Product Owner signs off on acceptance criteria verification
Zero High/Critical CVEs in production-bound artifacts
70% unit / 20% integration / 10% E2E target met or deviation explained

blockingCriteria.action: BLOCK RC stamp — remediate or waiver
BLOCK RC stamp — return to validation
BLOCK RC stamp — remediation plan required

gates.name: Production Live
gates.description: Deployment executed; observability verified nominal; monitoring active; rollback procedure confirmed.

mandatoryEvidence.validation: Release scope, deployment steps, rollback procedure, observability checklist all present and complete
Metrics nominal, logs flowing, traces complete for all production paths
Rollback steps documented and tested. Last good version identified.
Deployment artifacts (images, configs) traceable to RC

blockingCriteria.action: BLOCK Production Live — investigate before deploy
BLOCK Production Live — document rollback first

blockingCriteria.criterion: Release is not traceable to RC
blockingCriteria.action: BLOCK Production Live — ensure RC → Release chain
